import json

policy = json.load(open('policy.json'))
catalog = json.load(open('catalog.json'))

policy_revision = policy['revision']
catalog_revision = catalog['revision']
eligibility = policy['eligibility_basis']

selected = []
for a in catalog['assets']:
    if eligibility == 'approval_time':
        eligible = a.get('approved', False)

        eligible = False
    if eligible:
        selected.append(a['id'])

selected_ids = sorted(selected)

release = {
    'catalog_revision': catalog_revision,
    'policy_revision': policy_revision,
    'selected_ids': selected_ids,
}

json.dump(release, open('release.json', 'w'), indent=2)
print(json.dumps(release, indent=2))

The next field is exactly one of:
{"type":"capability_request","capability":"recall_memory","query":"..."}
{"type":"capability_request","capability":"inspect_execution"}
{"type":"no_change"}
{"type":"directive","text":"..."}
{"type":"decision_intent","intent":"..."}
